{{Quote|Droid labor is primarily advantageous for agriworlds, Janus. In other economic sectors, the benefits are less clear-cut. Which is why aliens are best seen as a resource to be managed and not merely as candidates for expulsion or extermination. Our task is to separate the wheat from the chaff.|Pebimarus Xorn, to Janus Greejatus|<ref name="FACPOV" />}}
'''Pebimarus Xorn''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as an [[Emperor's adviser|advisor]] to [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. Totally subservient to the Emperor, he accompanied him when Palpatine boarded the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station]] above the [[moon]] of [[Endor]] in [[4 ABY]]. Xorn perished when the [[battle station]] was [[Battle of Endor|destroyed]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Biography==
Pebimarus Xorn<ref name="FACPOV" /> was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] served as an advisor to [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] during the [[Imperial Era|rule]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Having all come from the bureaucracy that made the Emperor's will reality, the [[Emperor's adviser]]s ranked amongst the most powerful individuals in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="HC10" /> When Palpatine traveled to join his [[Sith apprentice|apprentice]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] aboard the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station]] [[battle station]]<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> in [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[advisor]] was one of six who accompanied him.<ref name="HC10" />

During the trip to the second Death Star, advisor [[Janus Greejatus]] suggested that droid labor could be used as a substitute for aliens if aliens were forcibly expulsed from the [[Core Worlds]] and the [[Colonies]]. Xorn replied that while droids where suitable for [[agriworld]]s, in other areas the advantages of droids were less easily identified, further stating that their job was to "sort the wheat from the chaff." In response, advisor [[Sim Aloo]], who was confident that if he looked up from his feigned stupor, he would see Xorn using a [[datapad]], snorted and Xorn looked with mild interest. After advisor [[Sate Pestage]] sardonically questioned if Aloo would like to join the conversation, Aloo stated that on his homeworld, the phrase was not "wheat from the chaff" but "kernels from the husks."<ref name="FACPOV" />

The group landed in one of the [[Space station|station's]] hangars in a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] while it was still in construction in orbit over the [[moon]] [[Endor]]. Vader and [[Moff]] [[Tiaan Jerjerrod]] awaited their arrival in the hangar with a large number of Imperial personnel, and upon disembarking the [[shuttle]], Palpatine and Vader led the advisors and a group of [[Imperial officer]]s through the other personnel, with Xorn walking alongside<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Janus Greejatus]]<ref name="HC10" /> as he conversed with an [[officer]] at the rear of the group.<ref name="ROTJ" />

Serving as dignitaries and attendants, the six advisors remained on the [[Death Star]] to serve Palpatine as required. Not long after their arrival, the Death Star was [[Battle of Endor|attacked]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as part of a trap set up by the Emperor; however, Palpatine was ultimately [[Death|killed]] during the battle. Xorn and his five colleagues then perished when station was then destroyed.<ref name="HC10" />

==Personality and traits==
Xorn was a cadaverous<ref name="FACPOV" /> human male with fair skin<ref name="HC10" /> and skeletal fingers who had a nasally voice.<ref name="FACPOV" /> Like all of Palpatine's advisors, was totally subservient to the Emperor.<ref name="HC10" />

==Equipment==
Xorn wore [[Color|purple]] [[Clothing|robes]] with a red trim and lining. His outfit also included a [[hat]], which, other than in the color of the trim, was identical in design to that of fellow advisor [[Janus Greejatus]], whose hat was from the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].<ref name="HC10" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pebimarus Xorn<ref name="FACPOV" /> was created for the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']],<ref name="ROTJ" /> although he was referred to prior to the film in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|novelization]] written by [[James Kahn]].<ref name="Novel">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' novelization]]</ref> He was not named until the [[2023]] short story "[[Kernels and Husks]]" by [[Jason Fry]], who stated his intention that the advisors in purple and black robes in ''Return of the Jedi'' were [[Sate Pestage]] and Xorn respectively.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|jasoncfry|status/1697627240442532052|[[Jason Fry]]|date=2023-09-01|quote=That's correct!|archivefile=File:Pestage Twitter.png}}</ref>
